lessons.title: 1. Dot Product & Similarity
lessons.description: Calculate dot product between two numerical feature vectors in Python.
lessons.starter_code:
def dot_product(vec_a: list[float], vec_b: list[float]) -> float:
    return sum(a * b for a, b in zip(vec_a, vec_b))
